Solidity.Roadmap.V16.finite_memory_compi.type:
∀ {C : Solidity.Contract} {b : Nat} {Γ Δ : Solidity.Ctx} {F : Solidity.Evm.Frag Γ} {P : Solidity.Prog C Γ Δ}
  (compiled : Solidity.Evm.Compiler.Compilation b F P) (path : compiled.isMemory = true),
  Solidity.Evm.Compiler.compile b F P = some compiled →
    Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileProg b F P = some (Solidity.Roadmap.V16.finiteMemoryCertificate compiled path)

premises.name: accepted
premises.type: Solidity.Evm.Compiler.compile b F P = some compiled

Solidity.Roadmap.V16.finite_memory_compi.type:
∀ {C : Solidity.Contract} {b : Nat} {Γ Ξ Δ : Solidity.Ctx} {F : Solidity.Evm.Frag Γ} {P : Solidity.Prog C Γ Ξ}
  {Q : Solidity.Prog C Ξ Δ} (head : Solidity.Evm.Memory.CompiledProg b F P)
  (tail : Solidity.Evm.Memory.CompiledProg b head.frag Q),
  Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileProg b F P = some head →
    Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileProg b head.frag Q = some tail →
      ∃ out,
        Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileProg b F (Solidity.Roadmap.V16.constructionAppend P Q) = some out ∧
          out.frag = tail.frag ∧ out.code = head.code ++ tail.code

premises.name: compiledHead
premises.type: Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileProg b F P = some head

premises.name: compiledTail
premises.type: Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileProg b head.frag Q = some tail

Solidity.Roadmap.V16.finite_memory_compi.type:
∀ {C : Solidity.Contract} {b : Nat} {Γ Ξ Δ : Solidity.Ctx} {F : Solidity.Evm.Frag Γ} {G : Solidity.Evm.Frag Ξ}
  {P : Solidity.Prog C Γ Ξ} {Q : Solidity.Prog C Ξ Δ} (head : Solidity.Evm.Memory.CompiledProg b F P)
  (tail : Solidity.Evm.Memory.CompiledProg b G Q),
  head.frag = G →
    Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileProg b F P = some head →
      Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileProg b G Q = some tail →
        Solidity.Roadmap.V16.finiteMemoryShape b F (Solidity.Roadmap.V16.constructionAppend P Q) =
          some (tail.frag, head.code ++ tail.code)

premises.name: compiledHead
premises.type: Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileProg b F P = some head

premises.name: compiledTail
premises.type: Solidity.Evm.Memory.compileProg b G Q = some tail

Solidity.Roadmap.V16.finite_memory_publi.type:
∀ {C : Solidity.Contract} {b : Nat} {Γ Ξ Δ : Solidity.Ctx} {F : Solidity.Evm.Frag Γ} {G : Solidity.Evm.Frag Ξ}
  {P : Solidity.Prog C Γ Ξ} {Q : Solidity.Prog C Ξ Δ} {R : Solidity.Prog C Γ Δ}
  (whole : Solidity.Evm.Compiler.Compilation b F R),
  whole.isMemory = true →
    ∀ (head : Solidity.Evm.Compiler.Compilation b F P),
      head.isMemory = true →
        ∀ (tail : Solidity.Evm.Compiler.Compilation b G Q),
          tail.isMemory = true →
            head.frag = G →
              Solidity.Roadmap.V16.constructionAppend P Q = R →
                Solidity.Evm.Compiler.compile b F R = some whole →
                  Solidity.Evm.Compiler.compile b F P = some head →
                    Solidity.Evm.Compiler.compile b G Q = some tail →
                      whole.code = head.code ++ tail.code ∧ whole.frag = tail.frag

premises.name: compiledWhole
premises.type: Solidity.Evm.Compiler.compile b F R = some whole

premises.name: compiledHead
premises.type: Solidity.Evm.Compiler.compile b F P = some head

premises.name: compiledTail
premises.type: Solidity.Evm.Compiler.compile b G Q = some tail

Solidity.Roadmap.V16.intrinsic_append_ru.type:
∀ {C : Solidity.Contract} {Γ Ξ Δ : Solidity.Ctx} (P : Solidity.Prog C Γ Ξ) (Q : Solidity.Prog C Ξ Δ)
  (σ : Solidity.State C Γ),
  Solidity.Prog.run σ (Solidity.Roadmap.V16.constructionAppend P Q) =
    Except.bind (Solidity.Prog.run σ P) fun o =>
      Except.map (fun u => { st := u.st, ext := ⋯ }) (Solidity.Prog.run o.st Q)

Solidity.Roadmap.V16.intrinsic_append_bo.type:
∀ {C : Solidity.Contract} {Γ Ξ Δ : Solidity.Ctx} (P : Solidity.Prog C Γ Ξ) (Q : Solidity.Prog C Ξ Δ)
  (σ : Solidity.State C Γ) (φ : Solidity.Spec C Δ),
  Solidity.Spec.sat σ (Solidity.Spec.box (Solidity.Roadmap.V16.constructionAppend P Q) φ) ↔
    Solidity.Spec.sat σ (Solidity.Spec.box P (Solidity.Spec.box Q φ))

Solidity.Roadmap.V16.intrinsic_append_di.type:
∀ {C : Solidity.Contract} {Γ Ξ Δ : Solidity.Ctx} (P : Solidity.Prog C Γ Ξ) (Q : Solidity.Prog C Ξ Δ)
  (σ : Solidity.State C Γ) (φ : Solidity.Spec C Δ),
  Solidity.Spec.sat σ (Solidity.Spec.diamond (Solidity.Roadmap.V16.constructionAppend P Q) φ) ↔
    Solidity.Spec.sat σ (Solidity.Spec.diamond P (Solidity.Spec.diamond Q φ))

Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.type:
∃ o m' base',
  Solidity.Prog.run Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.initial Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.P =
      Except.ok o ∧
    Solidity.Evm.run Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.compiled.code
          Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.machine =
        Solidity.Evm.Out.ok m' 0 ∧
      m'.stack = [Solidity.Evm.Word.val ⟨77, ⋯⟩] ∧
        Solidity.Evm.Memory.StateRepr 1 1 6 Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.compiled.frag o.st base' m' ∧
          Solidity.Evm.Memory.BaseExtends Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.initial.H
              Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.bases base' ∧
            Solidity.Evm.Memory.StructAllocatorRepr o.st.heap base' 6 ⟨21, ⋯⟩ m'

            Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.initial Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.machine o.st m' ∧
          Solidity.Spec.sat o.st Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.post ∧
            Solidity.Evm.Memory.AllocSourceExamples.sourceObserve✝ (Except.ok o) = some [2, 1, 0, 0, 3, 3] ∧
              Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.targetObserve (Solidity.Evm.Out.ok m' 0) =
                some [1, 21, 3, 16, 20, 99, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0]

∃ o m',

    Solidity.Evm.run Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.compiled.code
          Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.machine =
        Solidity.Evm.Out.ok m' 0 ∧
      m'.stack = [Solidity.Evm.Word.val ⟨77, ⋯⟩] ∧
        Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.compiled.Rep 1 6 Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.bases
            Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.initial Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.machine o.st m' ∧
          Solidity.Spec.sat o.st Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.post

∃ o m',
  Solidity.Prog.run Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.initial
        Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.callerPrefix =
      Except.ok { st := Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.reached, ext := ⋯ } ∧
    Solidity.Evm.run Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.prefixCompiled.code
          Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.machine =
        Solidity.Evm.Out.ok Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.reachedMachine 0 ∧
      Solidity.Prog.run Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.reached
            Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.suffix =
          Except.ok o ∧
        Solidity.Evm.run Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.suffixCompiled.code
              Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.reachedMachine =
            Solidity.Evm.Out.ok m' 0 ∧
          Solidity.Prog.run Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.initial
                Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.P =
              Except.ok o ∧
            Solidity.Evm.run Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.compiled.code
                  Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.machine =
                Solidity.Evm.Out.ok m' 0 ∧
              m'.stack = [Solidity.Evm.Word.val ⟨77, ⋯⟩] ∧
                Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.prefixCompiled.Rep 1 6
                    Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.bases Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.initial
                    Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.machine Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.reached
                    Solidity.Roadmap.V16.MixedMemoryControls.reachedMachine ∧
